answer: Sybil tax blocks fake identities: each new agent must burn a sunk 50-coin fee before earning, non-refundable. One honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards. Forging 100 identities costs 5,000 coins before any payout, wiping out the gain from flooding the pool. Falcon-eyed auditors sample work; a whisper of collusion triggers a recheck, and fakes riding the same tide of trades lose their deposits, so forgery costs more than it earns.
